executiveAssessment.text: Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel currently shows AI Consideration of 11.9% and Scenario Presence of 29.2%, with Reality Coverage at 37.5%. Strongest governed signal: Strong visibility for Leisure Travel. Primary constraint: Not appearing consistently in AI answers. Versus the prior published run (2026-08-20), material headline movement is AI Consideration -1.2 pp and Scenario Presence -3.1 pp. Independent Positioning metrics are included only where published. Independent Positioning is weak as well, so the Core and portfolio reads point in the same direction. Overall Core performance remains weak; gaps are broad across consideration, scenario coverage, and Independent Positioning. Management should prioritize correcting clear visibility and reality gaps, then address the competitors that most often appear when the property is absent.

positiveSignal.title: Positive Signal
positiveSignal.body: For Leisure Travel searches, Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel appeared in 17.3% of AI answers, compared with 9.6% for the comparable hotels used in this analysis. That means the hotel was surfaced about 80% more often than the comparable hotels used in this analysis. In practical terms, this is the area where the hotel is showing its clearest visibility advantage versus similar hotels.

secondaryCallout.title: Performance Risk
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 29.2% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 11.9% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.
